summary: Iteration 11 - Frontend-only testing of UI updates: All 10 features verified. (1) Properties page 'Refresh' button replaces 'Sync from OTA', (2) 6-column grid layout on Properties page, (3) Property cards show Name/Address/Owner/Status/LastSync/QuickView, (4) OTA Settings removed from sidebar, (5) Bookings Calendar+List toggle working, (6) Calendar shows monthly grid with color-coded bookings, (7) List view table has all required columns, (8) Property & Status filters functional, (9) Calendar booking click opens details popup, (10) Teal color theme applied (HSL 168 76% 32%).

issues: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility improvement needed
